exposure: Pre-pregnancy normal weight body mass index
cohort: The study included 946 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who had singleton pregnancies.
finding: Underweight women with GDM, compared to normal weight women with GDM, experienced a generally benign pregnancy course but had a higher risk of giving birth to small for gestational age neonates.
mod_finding: Underweight women with GDM had a higher rate of vaginal delivery and a lower rate of cesarean delivery compared to normal weight women with GDM.
